subject: ARR accuracy spotlight: SKU mapping + next-step nudges
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rena Patel <rena.patel@nimblestats.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: ARR accuracy spotlight: SKU mapping + next-step nudges

Morning all — quick ask to tighten ARR visibility for Nimble Stats before our week-ending forecast. We spotted several open opportunities where amount and product mapping are inconsistent in the CRM. Goal: get the pipeline to a defensible state for finance forecasting by EOD Monday.

Key asks (small, discrete items):
- Ben / Lauren: run the SKU mapping lookup and flag deals where product is blank or mapped to a legacy SKU (expect ~6 deals).
- Marissa: confirm next-step cadence for the four deals in stage "Verifying" and update probability where you have supporting signals (PO issued, pilot feedback).
- Rena: can you confirm whether the latest purchase estimates are USD or local currency for the items in the attached sheet? We have two lines that look doubled.

Attachments: sku_mapping_v2.csv (stub), forecast-spotlight-notes.pdf (stub)

I pasted a short checklist below that we can mark in-thread as items are closed. This will be our source-of-truth for the forecast call.

Checklist:
1) Product/SKU resolved in CRM (SKU column populated)
2) Amount validated against customer PO or email
3) Next-step updated and owner assigned
4) Probability adjusted with a comment referencing evidence

Thanks — please reply with quick confirmations so I can consolidate into the forecast sheet.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Rena Patel <rena.patel@nimblestats.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ARR accuracy spotlight: SKU mapping + next-step nudges

Hi Soojin — thanks for the heads up. Quick clarifications from our side: we consolidated the pilot spend and the expected license ARR on the same line in our PO; the amounts in the spreadsheet are USD. Two notes:
- Line item "NS-ANALYTICS-CORE" is actually a three-month pilot (we list as "trial" in our procurement system) and should be mapped to SKU "NS-CORE-PILOT" not the full-production SKU.
- The larger line that looks doubled is an internal uplift for professional services and should be split out if you need ARR-only figures.

I attached an export from our procurement system (PDF stub) separately to the Hub doc. I can have procurement email a formal split if that helps with ARR reporting.

Thanks,
Rena

rena.patel@nimblestats.com | (650) 555-2210

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ARR accuracy spotlight: SKU mapping + next-step nudges

All — I pulled the list and ran the SKU mapping against sku_mapping_v2.csv. Results (summary):
- 5 deals had legacy SKUs; I updated three to the current NS-CORE-PILOT and left two pending confirm from customer.
- 2 deals had empty amount fields; emailed Rena asking for split (PS vs ARR) — see thread.
- I added a CRM comment on each deal linking the HubSpot record.

Next steps I'm taking today:
- Marking Product/SKU resolved where we have clear mapping (5 deals).
- Leaving a probability note for the two pilot deals: set to 60% until we get a signed split or PO.
- Assigning follow-up tasks to Marissa for the "Verifying" stage deals; Marissa — can you push two status calls and update next-step dates?

Attachment: updated rows in sku_mapping_v2.csv (stub)

Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ARR accuracy spotlight: SKU mapping + next-step nudges

Quick update — called into both "Verifying" accounts this morning. Outcomes:
- Account A (Deal ID: 8342-A): customer confirmed pilot mapping to NS-CORE-PILOT; procurement to send split PO by Mon EOD. Updated next-step to "Awaiting split PO" and set probability to 70% with CRM comment linking the procurement contact.
- Account B (Deal ID: 8342-B): customer requested revised quote to separate PS from ARR; scheduled call Tue 12/15. Left probability at 40% until quotation accepted.

Checklist status:
1) Product/SKU resolved in CRM — 5/6 done
2) Amount validated against customer PO or email — 2/6 validated; 2 pending customer split; 2 need confirmation
3) Next-step updated and owner assigned — done for Verifying stage deals
4) Probability adjusted with comment — done where evidence exists

I'll push the updated CRM export to the shared sheet and ping finance once the split PO arrives. Great coordination everyone.

— Marissa
